fields.Name: T096 - Record Change History Create Version Label
fields.Description: Covers the version-label feature of the history panel (OpenCreateWizard, Version Labels section) — a distinct capability from the change timeline, filter pills, and restore flow.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click an event row, then 'Open Full Record'. Open the Record Changes drawer via the history (clock) button. Near the top there is a 'Version Labels' area with a 'Create a version label for this record' button (and, when none exist, a 'No version labels for this record yet.' empty state). Click the create button to open the version-label creation wizard. Success is the version-labels area rendering and the create-label wizard opening — you do NOT need to complete and save the label. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Record Changes drawer shows a 'Version Labels' area (with either existing labels or a 'No version labels' empty state)
Clicking the create-version-label button opens the label-creation wizard/form
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
